t: Peak Data Theory? Why the Future of Search Hinges on Outlier Information
s: The 'peak data theory' is a myth; vast untapped data exists in the invisible web and through continuous generation. While synthetic data supplements, real-world data, curated effectively, remains crucial for AI.
sub: Invisible web offers vast untapped data for AI training, accessible via advanced web scraping.
Continuous data generation fuels AI, with curation being key to extracting high-quality datasets.
Synthetic data is a valuable supplement for AI training but lacks the complexity of real-world data.
